terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: ATHLETE CORE is an app that connects strength coaches with their clients. To use it you need an account and, as a client, the code your coach gives you.
terms.p2: You are responsible for keeping your password safe. Don't share your account with anyone.
terms.p3: Your coach decides the training they give you. ATHLETE CORE is not responsible for that training and does not replace medical advice.
terms.p4: Your coach can stop giving you access at any time. Your account is still yours.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We store your name, your email, your language and unit preferences, and the training data you record.
privacy.p2: Your coach sees your name and the data of the space you share. Your coach doesn't see your email.
privacy.p3: We don't use tracking cookies and we don't send you marketing emails.
privacy.p4: You can ask us to delete your account by writing to the support address. Deleting it from inside the app will come later.

coachTerms.title: Terms for coaches
coachTerms.p1: As a coach, you use ATHLETE CORE to run your business and your clients' training.
coachTerms.p2: ATHLETE CORE processes your clients' data on your behalf, only to provide the service (data processing agreement).
coachTerms.p3: You decide which clients have access and you can remove them at any time. Your plan sets how many active clients you can have.
coachTerms.p4: Until payments arrive, ATHLETE CORE sets your plan. You can't change it from the app.
